NO HIRE — leaning strongly to close.

Rationale (short):
- System design depth was inconsistent across panels; candidate handled day-to-day SRE tasks well but struggled on distributed control-plane design and cross-cluster failure modes which this role must own.
- Scorecard shows variance: 2x "meets" and 2x "below" in architecture/design.
- Compensation ask is at the top of band; bridging the gap would make hiring economics unfavorable compared to other strong candidates in pipeline.

Suggested next steps:
- Close this candidate with a gracious "not moving forward" message and preserve the market-intel notes in Greenhouse.
- I support reallocate headcount to a narrow search: Senior Platform Reliability (observability/automation focus) rather than a general infra reliability hire. We can reframe the req and move to targeted sourcing.

-Michael
